hunts.name: Rhona Dinsmore
hunts.start: Unlocks after the main mission This Old Cove. Rhona is at the Assassin's Bureau on the southeast edge of Havana; you hear fighting before the marker appears. Speaking to her starts the first mission.
hunts.reward: One Templar Key, dropped by the final target Hilary Flint. The last mission ends with a report back to Rhona at the Bureau.

missions.name: Bureau Under Attack
steps: Defend the Bureau against three waves of soldiers coming through three entrances.
Before a wave, pick up the powder kegs in the courtyard and carry them to the entrances.
Shoot a keg when guards bunch up at an entrance to clear several at once.
Finish off survivors with swords and pistols.
Survive all three waves to complete the mission.
tips: Health and ammo sit on the tables in front of the Bureau.
Kegs are optional, but one shot can kill several soldiers.
Sources differ on whether Rhona places a keg every round or only between waves.
gaps: Pages do not describe what each wave contains.

missions.name: A Thief in the Market
steps: Find Rhona on a stone pergola roof in northwest Havana and talk to her.
Go northeast to the market and use Eagle Vision to spot two glowing merchants; talk to both.
Sit on a nearby bench until the thief appears and runs.
Chase him; he ends up at a dead end near stairs and a patio and fights.
Defeat him and loot the body for the Pickpocketed Map, which reveals three gunpowder stores.
Clear any wanted level, then report back to Rhona at the Bureau.
tips: He is slow, so catching him is easy; wait at the dead end if you fall behind.
The mission will not complete while you are wanted.
gaps: No exact map coordinates for the market.

missions.name: Arms Race
steps: Destroy three gunpowder reserves shown on the map.
Reserve 1 (northeast, between buildings): deal with the rooftop sniper, then shoot the barrel from a rooftop; the other source says to double-assassinate the two guards in front and ignite it.
Reserve 2 (northwest, under a pergola): remove the two rooftop snipers with rooftop takedowns or the Rope Dart, double-assassinate the guards at the barrel, then ignite it.
Reserve 3 (further northwest, in an alcove): guards and snipers cover it; whistle guards over one at a time from bushes, or drop in behind the awning, then ignite it.
If there is no clean approach, detonate a barrel by hand and run clear.
tips: Stealth is not required.
Blast damage close to a barrel is heavy, so get away after igniting.
The Jackdaw can take damage in the missions before Flint's End.
gaps: The two pages describe the layout and order of reserves 1 and 2 differently.

missions.name: Flint's End
steps: Find Rhona on a dockside rooftop and follow her across the rooftops to the docks.
She drops down and draws the guards around Hilary Flint.
Once guards converge on her, drop down and mark Flint with Eagle Vision.
Flint retreats to the pier and shoots from range; close in and fight with swords.
Hold the interact button beside his body to confirm the kill (Templar Key).
Watch the cutscene and return to Rhona at the Bureau to close the hunt.
tips: An explosive barrel on the pier next to him gives a faster kill.

gaps: Sources disagree on this key's number (one calls it key 2, another says four keys in total).
Mobalytics pages returned 403 and were not read.
gamingpromax suggests doing this hunt first (shortest, no sailing); not confirmed elsewhere.

hunts.name: Anto
hunts.start: Anto is inside the Assassin's Bureau in Kingston; speak to him to begin. gamingpromax says the hunt only unlocks after the main mission A Governor No Longer; games.gg lists no prerequisite.
hunts.reward: One Templar Key, dropped by the final target Kenneth Abraham; return to Anto at the Bureau to close the hunt.

missions.name: The Maroon Assassin
steps: Enter the Kingston tavern and take the Notice of Dismissal from the desk.
It points to a nearby church; listen to the guards there, who then scatter.
One guard walks off alone to the left, two go right; follow the lone one.
Catch and tackle him, then question him.
Report back to Anto at the Bureau.
tips: Going left at the church is easier than chasing the pair.
gaps: Exact tavern and church locations are not given.

missions.name: Recruiting Maroons
steps: Follow Anto to the area before entering the guarded zones.
Optionally hire the nearby drunkards for 150 Reales so they draw guards' attention.
Visit the three green markers and kill the guards holding each group of prisoners; aerial assassinations from rooftops work.
After all three are freed, spot the guard officer with Eagle Vision (green marker over his head).
Hide in a haystack and whistle guards over one by one, saving the officer for last.
Go south to the cemetery to meet Anto, then return to the Bureau.
tips: Stealth is not required.
The drunkards pull several guards away from you.
gaps: games.gg spells the currency 'Reules', gamingpromax 'Reales'; the amount is 150 on both.

missions.name: Under Attack
steps: Talk to Anto at the Bureau; soldiers attack at once.
Hold the Bureau through three waves (the second harder, the third the final push).
Use the healing items and ammo stocked inside between waves.
Check the rooftop, since the last enemy of the final wave tends to stay there.
Afterwards speak to Anto; he sends you to meet him at the marketplace for the final mission.
tips: Look at the rooftops before assuming a wave is over.

missions.name: The Commander's Ruse
steps: Tail the officers in the marketplace to a restricted party area.
Listen to the officers at the entrance: Kenneth Abraham is near the buffet in the north.
Sit in a bush, whistle a guard over, kill him, then move to the next bush, working north.
Use the same trick to lure Kenneth into a bush and kill him there to avoid a full alert.
If you lose him, use Eagle Vision near the buffet to reveal his marker.
Collect the Templar Key and return to Anto at the Bureau.
tips: Stealth is easiest here but not required.

gaps: The prerequisite (A Governor No Longer) is stated by only one source.
Sources call this key either the fourth key or one of four.
Mobalytics pages returned 403 and were not read.

hunts.name: Vance Travers
hunts.start: Unlocks after This Old Cove. The hunt is listed as Upton Travers, but it begins when you speak to his brother Vance, outside a small wooden house on the south coast of Eleuthera, Nassau.
hunts.reward: Third Templar Key per the sources, dropped by the final target Jing Lang; report to Upton to close the hunt.

missions.name: Oh Brother...
steps: Head north to the market and enter the marked Explore area.
Use Eagle Vision to spot Upton's men (green).
Tail them to the hideout, or fight them; killing them shrinks the search area.
Follow the marker west to the hideout, where Upton is in a courtyard.
Approach through grass or from the rooftops and try to kill him.
A cutscene stops it: Upton runs the local Assassin Bureau and Vance lied to you. Go to Upton at the Bureau.
tips: Fighting the men is fine and makes the hideout easier to find.

missions.name: The Other Brother
steps: Meet Upton at the Nassau Bureau and follow him to a vantage point.
Hide in nearby bushes and eavesdrop on Upton and Vance; follow Upton afterwards.
Kill Jing Lang's men around a house, garden guards first, then the pair at the entrance.
Search the house for Jing Lang's letter on a wooden crate; it says Vance took his half of the map to meet her.
Go to the tavern and eavesdrop on Vance and Jing Lang unseen; hiding under the wooden stairs beside it works.
Learn that Vance hired killers for Upton; return to the hideout, beat the soldiers and defend Upton.
Talk to Upton, who then heads to the tavern.
tips: The next mission starts as soon as you speak to Upton, so do not linger.
gaps: Pages disagree on where the letter lies (right side of the house vs north side under an awning).

missions.name: Upton's Sorrow
steps: Meet drunk Upton at the tavern; he starts a brawl.
Beat the attackers while keeping Upton safe.
Escort him home; when he stops for dancers, pay them 100 Reales.
Kill the guards drawn by Upton relieving himself in the street.
Talk to Upton to finish.
tips: Carry at least 100 Reales first; the payment is required.
gaps: gamingpromax splits the tavern part into a separate mission named A Grave Error, so mission names and boundaries differ by source.

missions.name: Queen of Pirates, King of Fools
steps: Find sober Upton in the eastern swamp; he asks you to kill Vance and recover the key.
Move through the trees to bypass guards, killing those loading a boat if you wish.
Use Eagle Vision and look north for a green marker beside a white tent.
Clear guards near the tent and assassinate Vance; a sleep dart can knock him out first.
After the cutscene Jing Lang flees into the swamp; chase her until she stops to fight with two guards.
Defeat the guards, then kill Jing Lang to get the Templar Key.
Report back to Upton.
tips: Jing Lang takes no damage while running, so save ammo.
gaps: gamingpromax calls the last mission A Governor No Longer and describes only Jing Lang as the target.
Mission names conflict between sources (Upton's Sorrow / A Grave Error; Queen of Pirates, King of Fools / A Governor No Longer).
Mobalytics pages returned 403 and were not read.

hunts.name: Opia Anito
hunts.start: Opia is at Castillo de Jagua on Cayman Sound. The sources spell her name Apito. Hostile ships patrol the approach: sink them, or leave the Jackdaw 200 to 300 metres out and swim in.
hunts.reward: Digested Map Piece (mission 1) and the final Templar Key (fifth per the sources) from Lucia Marquez; completes all four hunts and the Damn Fine Gear side quest.

missions.name: The Taino Assassin
steps: Greet Opia and follow her into the camp.
Use Eagle Vision on the tree with claw marks and the blood puddle; talk to Opia.
Follow the trail to the dead guards and take the right branch at the fork.
Kill the White Jaguar.
Watch the cutscene, then go to the docks in the far east of Castillo de Jagua near Grand Cayman.
tips: Sleep dart then assassinate for a one-move kill.
Without darts use heavy attacks and dodge its charges.

missions.name: Templar Ships
steps: Follow Opia to the Grand Cayman docks; she asks you to investigate the Templar presence.
Sit on the bench at the marker and listen to two locals talk about the King of Fishermen.
Go west to the Viewpoint and use Eagle Vision in the search zone to spot the King.
Tail him and pickpocket the Bill of Sale from behind.
Meet Opia east of Grand Cayman near the Viewpoint and hand it over.
tips: If he sees you he turns hostile and you must fight him.
gaps: gamingpromax mentions naval combat in this mission; games.gg does not.

missions.name: Right-Hand Man
steps: Opia explains that Vargas is Lucia Marquez's right hand and takes you to his house.
Hide in the hay bale across from his door; when Opia knocks, Vargas runs.
Chase him on foot; he escapes by ship, so pursue in the Jackdaw.
Damage his ship enough to board without sinking it.
Board and kill Vargas.
tips: Too much cannon fire fails the objective.
Clearing the whole crew first can trigger a marker bug with no target; reload your last save.
Repair the Jackdaw before heading to Pinos Isle.
gaps: gamingpromax describes this only as tracking Vargas and killing him and his guards, without the ship chase.

missions.name: The Trail of Lucia Marquez
steps: Meet Opia on the Pinos Isle beach and wait until night.
Go through the Templar camp with her, using bushes and shared takedowns on guards.
At the ziggurat ruins, kill all seven of Lucia's men; a second wave follows, so keep Opia safe.
Use Eagle Vision to find Lucia east of the ruins; she runs with two guards.
Clear her guards and kill her; hold the interact button to confirm.
Watch the cutscene and talk to Opia to close the hunt (final key).
tips: Sleep darts thrown at clustered groups keep the ziggurat fight quiet.
gaps: Pinos Isle docks are guarded; sink the ships or swim in.
Name spelling: the brief says Anito, the sources say Apito.
Mobalytics pages returned 403 and were not read.
Map coordinates for the start (304, 311) come from one source only.
Mobalytics pages returned 403; Vulkk and Gamerguides Resynced pages were not fetched.
Key numbering conflicts: the suit cage needs five keys, the first from the story mission, so the hunts give keys 2 to 5, but some pages say four keys in total.
Per-mission reales rewards were only found for the original game (Prima), not Resynced, so none are recorded.
Mission names and splits differ between sources for the Vance Travers hunt.
notes: Reconciled from games.gg, gamingpromax and allthings.how (Resynced pages). Rewritten in own words; conflicts are listed in gaps.
